The main takeaway from our work is that

human herpesvirus-8 immunohistochemical positivity can be seen in both primary effusion lymphomas as well as Kaposi sarcomas and that a careful assessment of the histologic features of the lesion in addition to the immunohistochemical profile of the human herpesvirus is required to make a correct diagnosis.
